parsed.explanation: L3.2 requires, for every Liu division, an explicit Xiang reply with at most n = q-1 marks realizing D <= |Sigma(A) - Sigma(B)|. The write-up's only construction for the case B nonempty is the overlay sentence, which asserts both the equal-pairing of common-refinement cells and the cut count and then writes 'standard; details omitted'. Nothing elsewhere supplies it: the later remark ('All overlay cuts described above lie strictly inside an original interval...') only addresses coincident boundaries, and Section 3 supplies only the pigeonhole Gamma <= 1/(2^{n+1}-1). The correct count (|A|+|B|-1 overlay cuts plus q-|A|-|B| bisections = q-1) and the pairing verification are absent, so the mechanism is named, not carried out.
